events.text:
`CartEndpoint` has a single injected dependency: `ShoppingCartService`, via field injection at CartEndpoint.java:30-31 (`@Inject private ShoppingCartService shoppingCartService`). That's the only `@Inject`/`@EJB` in the class.

For dependents of `ShoppingCartService`: only `CartEndpoint` uses it — it's the sole importer (CartEndpoint.java:22) and the only class holding a reference (line 31). All of its methods (`getCart`, `checkout`, `add`, `set`, `delete`, `dedupeCartItems`) call into it. No other service class references `ShoppingCartService`; the broader `callers`/`injects` matches on `Transformers.shoppingCartToJson` were false positives from the similarly named `ShoppingCart` type, and a source grep confirms no other file mentions `ShoppingCartService`.

So it's a single-consumer service: `CartEndpoint` → `ShoppingCartService`.

events.text:
No class in the Java source actually uses Java reflection (`Class.forName`, `getDeclared*`, `setAccessible`, `invoke`, `newInstance` all return zero hits). The closest "reflective" wiring is dynamic/name-based lookup:

- `ShoppingCartService.java:121` resolves the remote EJB at runtime: `context.lookup("ejb:/ROOT/ShippingService!" + ShippingServiceRemote.class.getName())` (JNDI `InitialContext` at line 119).
- `InventoryNotificationMDB.java:56-60,72-77` does WebLogic JNDI lookups via `InitialContext`/`PortableRemoteObject.narrow`.
- `Producers.java:13-14` uses CDI `InjectionPoint.getMember().getDeclaringClass()` — runtime-reflective producer for `Logger`.

Controllers (request/message entry points whose names don't say "controller"):
- JAX-RS resources: `CartEndpoint`, `OrderEndpoint`, `ProductEndpoint` (registered by `RestApplication`), plus base `RestApplication` itself.
- Message-driven bean `OrderServiceMDB` (`@MessageDriven`, topic/orders) — asynchronous message controller.
- `InventoryNotificationMDB` implements `MessageListener` but has no `@MessageDriven`/XML wiring, so it's inactive legacy, not a live controller.
- `StartupListener` (WebLogic `ApplicationLifecycleListener`) and `DataBaseMigrationStartup` (`@Startup`, Flyway) are lifecycle/startup hooks, not request controllers.

events.text:
Cart module spans `rest/CartEndpoint`, `service/ShoppingCartService`, `service/ShoppingCartOrderProcessor`, models `ShoppingCart`/`ShoppingCartItem`, and `Transformers.shoppingCartToJson`.

Routes that move (all on `CartEndpoint`): `GET /services/cart/{cartId}`, `POST /services/cart/checkout/{cartId}`, `POST /services/cart/{cartId}/{itemId}/{quantity}`, `POST /services/cart/{cartId}/{tmpId}`, `DELETE /services/cart/{cartId}/{itemId}/{quantity}`.

Injected/dynamic dependencies crossing the boundary:
- `CartEndpoint` → `ShoppingCartService`.
- `ShoppingCartService` injects `ProductService`, `PromoService`, `ShoppingCartOrderProcessor`, `Logger`, and JNDI-looks up `ShippingServiceRemote` (ShoppingCartService.java:121).
- `ShoppingCartOrderProcessor` uses `JMSContext`/`Topic` `java:/topic/orders` (lines 23,30).

External classes that would break:
- `PromoService.applyCartItemPromotions` (:32) and `applyShippingPromotions` (:63) take `ShoppingCart`/`ShoppingCartItem`.
- `ShippingService.calculateShipping` (:15) and `calculateShippingInsurance` (:48) take `ShoppingCart`.
- Async contract: processor publishes `shoppingCartToJson` to `topic/orders` (:30), consumed by `OrderServiceMDB` (:15) which injects `OrderService` and `CatalogService`.

Blast radius on `CartEndpoint` is 40.15, top impacted files `Transformers.java` and `ShoppingCartOrderProcessor.java` — plus Promo/Shipping become the seam to redefine.
